example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, the operations manager's corporate card, September statement. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

chosen.CC_Recon_OperationsManager_2026-09.xlsx: the file name that the skill gives the workpaper, with the cardholder by role, for September of the example year 2026

messages.text: Can you reconcile the operations manager's company card for September?
Yes. Before I read anything, I need seven answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload files?
Which card is it, and who holds it? I record the holder by role, never by card number.
Which statement period is it? Does it match your accounting month?
Please attach the card statement. I always need it, because MosoFin cannot read it.
Please attach the receipts, or an export from your receipt tool. Without them, I cannot match receipts.
Below what amount is no receipt necessary? Above what amount is a purchase an asset? I never assume either amount.
Can you reclaim tax on card spend, and where?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. It is the operations manager's corporate card. The statement runs 1 to 30 September, same as our month. Receipts under $75 are not necessary. Assets start above $2,500. We do not reclaim tax on this card.

messages.label: Checked the workspace and the company file
messages.summary: The agent can read your books. It cannot change them.

messages.text: Here is my plan. I reconcile the **corporate card held by the operations manager** at **Northbrook Trading** for **1 to 30 September**. I read the books through MosoFin. No card platform is connected, so I use your statement and receipts.
messages.after: Your receipt threshold is **$75** and your capitalisation threshold is **$2,500**. I do not assess tax recovery. Shall I start?

messages.label: Read the books in one batch
rows: July and August, for the monthly tests
messages.summary: 13 reads in one batch. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: The statement closes at **$8,432.10**. Your books show **$8,623.60** for the card on 30 September. Two items explain the difference:

card.title: Statement to books
rows: Card liability in the books, 30 Sep
− Charge posted 30 Sep, on October's statement
+ Charge on the statement, never entered
Difference to the statement closing balance

messages.after: The $340 is timing. The issuer recorded it on 1 October, and next month I check that it cleared.

messages.text: The **$148.50** needs a person. It is a Saturday grocery-store purchase that nobody submitted. It has no receipt and no business purpose.
messages.after: I list it as a possible personal charge, and the cardholder owns the follow-up. I do not call it more than that.

messages.text: I matched your receipts to the charges. More charges above **$75** lack a matching receipt:

card.title: Receipt exceptions
head: Charges
Amount
What I found
rows: A file is attached, but its amount does not match

messages.after: An attached file is not a matched receipt. The cardholder owns each follow-up.

messages.text: One charge is in the wrong account. The laptop is over your **$2,500** line, but it is in Office Supplies:
messages.after: September's expenses are $2,900 too high, and your asset register does not have the laptop.

messages.text: Seven merchants charged the same amount each month from July to September. Here is what they cost in a year:

card.title: Subscriptions, a year
head: Subscription
A year
Note
rows: Does your team still use it?

messages.after: You decide which ones to keep. I found no charge that is in the books twice.

messages.text: I propose two entries. Each one points to its evidence:

card.title: Proposed entries
head: Entry
Amount
Evidence
rows: Move the laptop from Office Supplies to Computer Equipment

messages.after: Your books record each charge on its own, so I only propose corrections. If a person decides that the grocery charge is personal, it goes to Due from Employee. The $340 needs no entry. A person posts these entries. I do not.

messages.text: The card ties to the cent. Your workpaper has six sheets. The first sheet says that this is a reconciliation, not a review. The last sheet shows what I could not check.
messages.after: Do you want the workpaper as an Excel file?
Do you want me to save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Done. I saved the card by its holder's role, your two thresholds and the account for each regular merchant. I saved no card numbers and no spending.
